name: Minh Thanh Pagoda
summary: Minh Thanh Pagoda overlooks Pleiku from the hills. Vietnam Tourism notes it was built in 1964 with a 72 m gold-painted tower, a po mu wood ceiling, and carved wooden doors. It is a morning stop in town, not the same site as Buu Minh pagoda on the road toward Chu Đăng Ya.
